analysis.executiveSummary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. (Win Championship) proposes sending Tyler Warren, Tyler Shough, and a 2029 1st-round pick to Big Balder Brand (Win Championship) for Trey McBride. While Trey McBride (99.4 C-AVI) is an elite tight end, Tyler Warren (96.2 C-AVI, 24.0 yrs) is already a cornerstone TE1. Surrendering a 2029 1st-round pick and starting-caliber QB depth in Tyler Shough for a marginal +3.2 C-AVI upgrade at tight end represents a severe value drain and unnecessary capital expenditure for a championship contender.

submitted.summary: Corgi Loaf Baking Co. surrenders major future draft capital (2029 1st) and valuable QB depth (Tyler Shough) to secure a minimal +3.2 C-AVI upgrade at tight end. Big Balder Brand secures a massive net value advantage (+135.3 C-AVI / +147.0 D-AVI) while seamlessly replacing Trey McBride with another 24-year-old elite tight end in Tyler Warren.

recommended.summary: If Corgi Loaf Baking Co. wants to pursue Trey McBride, the offer should remove the 2029 1st pick and Tyler Shough, offering Tyler Warren plus a 2029 2nd-round pick instead. Even then, trading elite TE for elite TE remains a low-utility maneuver.

officialAviAnalysis.sideADynastyImpact: Net negative dynasty impact (-147.0 D-AVI). Corgi sends away 24-year-old Tyler Warren (90.5 D-AVI), 26-year-old QB Tyler Shough (70.0 D-AVI), and a 2029 1st (79.3 D-AVI) for 26-year-old Trey McBride (92.8 D-AVI).

officialAviAnalysis.valueAssessment: The submitted package heavily overpays for lateral tier-swapping. A 2029 1st pick and a starting QB are far too steep a price for a 3.2 C-AVI gain.

publicMarketAnalysis.summary: Consensus dynasty markets rate Trey McBride as the overall TE1/TE2 alongside Brock Bowers. Tyler Warren is consensus TE4 and rising rapidly. Tyler Shough's market value has surged following a strong start to the season in New Orleans.
publicMarketAnalysis.aviVsMarket: Public sentiment recognizes McBride's elite target share in Arizona, but also values 1st-round picks and emerging QBs like Shough highly. AVI correctly identifies that Warren's 96.2 C-AVI makes paying a 1st + Shough on top unviable for Corgi.

verdict.rationale: As Corgi Loaf Baking Co., your goal is to Win Championship. Tyler Warren (96.2 C-AVI, 24.0 yrs) is already a young cornerstone TE1. Trading Warren, starting-caliber QB depth (Tyler Shough), and a 2029 1st for Trey McBride (99.4 C-AVI) represents an overpay for a minimal +3.2 C-AVI starting lineup upgrade. Retaining your 2029 1st and QB depth provides significantly better championship resilience in a 16-team league.
